To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) knowledge management (KM) is a key factor in achieving a firm’s strategic objectives; (b) knowledge management is not a new concept but it is still not widely implemented; and (c) knowledge management is a complex process that requires a systematic and structured approach.

the KM process is a complex and multidimensional phenomenon, and that the KM process can be described by a model with four main phases: (i) the knowledge creation phase, (ii) the knowledge codification phase, (iii) the knowledge transfer phase, and (iv) the knowledge application phase.

knowledge sharing and knowledge management are positively related to organizational innovation, and that the knowledge management system has a mediating role between knowledge sharing and organizational innovation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (i) how to define knowledge contribution in the context of knowledge management; (ii) what the knowledge contribution is in the knowledge management process; and (iii) how to measure knowledge contribution in knowledge management process.
how to improve the performance of KM in organizations, which is the main purpose of this research.
the development of the knowledge management contribution measurement model (KCM) for the knowledge-based organizations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the KM process is a continuous cycle of knowledge acquisition, creation, storage, distribution, and application.
the KM contribution measurement model is a valuable tool for measuring and evaluating the contribution of knowledge management to organizational effectiveness.

KM is a complex process that is not easy to measure and that it is not a single activity but a combination of activities that are performed in a coordinated manner in order to achieve an organizational goal.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the model presented here is a contribution to the knowledge management field, as it is the first attempt to provide a framework that integrates the main aspects of the field and that is based on the most important knowledge management theories.
we have proposed a new model for measuring knowledge contribution.
knowledge management is a process of creating, sharing, and using knowledge, which can be seen as a process of knowledge creation, storage, and application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
knowledge management is not a one-size-fits-all approach, but rather a set of principles that can be adapted to fit the specific needs and goals of an organization.
